quizzes.title: Prétérit simple vs Prétérit en BE + -ING

questions.question: While she ... for her university exams, the electricity suddenly failed.
questions.explanation: On emploie le prétérit en BE + -ING (past continuous) pour décrire une action en cours d'accomplissement dans le passé lorsqu'un événement ponctuel au prétérit simple survient.

questions.question: The detective unlocked the door, walked inside, and ... the light switch.
questions.explanation: Une succession d'actions courtes et consécutives dans un récit au passé s'exprime systématiquement au prétérit simple.

questions.question: While the professor was lecturing on quantum mechanics, several students ... detailed notes.
questions.explanation: Deux actions simultanées et continues dans le passé peuvent toutes les deux être conjuguées au prétérit en BE + -ING.

questions.question: When I first met him in 2018, he ... three foreign languages fluently.
questions.explanation: Les verbes d'état ou de perception intellectuelle comme 'know' ne s'emploient généralement pas à la forme progressive (aspect BE + -ING).

questions.question: William Shakespeare ... 'Hamlet' around the year 1600.
questions.explanation: Une date ou un repère temporel passé précis et révolu ('around the year 1600') impose le prétérit simple.

questions.question: My former flatmate was always ... my clothes without asking for permission!
questions.explanation: L'association 'was/were always + V-ing' permet d'exprimer un agacement ou un reproche récurrent à propos d'une habitude passée.

questions.question: Outside, heavy rain was falling and an icy wind ... through the alleyways.
questions.explanation: Pour poser le décor ou planter l'arrière-plan narratif d'une scène, le prétérit continu est privilégié.

questions.question: As soon as she heard the fire alarm, the security guard ... out of her chair.
questions.explanation: Après 'as soon as', une réaction immédiate et ponctuelle est rendue par le prétérit simple.

questions.question: Suddenly, the night watchman ... footsteps echoing in the empty corridor.
questions.explanation: Les verbes de perception involontaire ('hear', 'see') refusent généralement la forme en -ING dans ce contexte ponctuel.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly combine the past simple and past continuous?
options: While we were driving through Scotland, our engine broke down.
The athlete slipped on the wet grass while she was sprinting to the finish line.
She was knowing the correct answer when the teacher asked her.
They were arriving at the airport yesterday at exactly six in the morning.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 articulent parfaitement une action d'arrière-plan en cours (past continuous) et un événement soudain interruptif (past simple). Le verbe 'know' ne s'emploie pas à l'aspect progressif.

quizzes.title: Past Perfect simple et Past Perfect continu

questions.question: By the time the rescue helicopter landed, the hikers ... in the freezing snow for six hours.
questions.explanation: Le Past Perfect continu (had been + V-ing) insiste sur la durée d'une activité ininterrompue qui s'étendait jusqu'à un repère précis du passé.

questions.question: The engineer felt completely exhausted because he ... non-stop since dawn.
questions.explanation: On utilise le Past Perfect continu pour expliquer la cause passée d'un état physique ou mental constaté à ce même moment du passé.

questions.question: David couldn't board the flight because he ... his passport at home.
questions.explanation: Le Past Perfect simple (had + participe passé) marque l'antériorité ponctuelle d'une action achevée par rapport à un autre événement passé.

questions.question: In 2020, my grandparents ... married for fifty years.
questions.explanation: Pour dresser un bilan de durée révolu à une date passée ('In 2020'), le Past Perfect s'impose.

questions.question: The business partners ... each other for twenty years before founding their startup.
questions.explanation: 'Know' est un verbe d'état : on emploie le Past Perfect simple et non la forme continue pour marquer la durée antérieure.

questions.question: Sarah's overalls were covered in dust because she ... the old attic all afternoon.
questions.explanation: Les traces visibles dans le passé (la poussière sur les vêtements) sont le résultat d'une activité continue exprimée au Past Perfect continu.

questions.question: By five o'clock yesterday, the novelist ... three full chapters of her autobiography.
questions.explanation: Quand on quantifie un résultat ou un nombre d'occurrences achevées ('three full chapters'), on emploie la forme simple et non progressive.

questions.question: The express train had already departed when the passengers ... onto the platform.
questions.explanation: L'événement antérieur est au Past Perfect ('had departed'), tandis que l'événement ultérieur s'exprime au prétérit simple ('rushed').

questions.question: It was the first time the young astronaut ... a spacecraft outside Earth's orbit.
questions.explanation: La structure 'It was the first/second time...' transposée dans le passé est obligatoirement suivie du Past Perfect.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly illustrate the use of the Past Perfect (simple or continuous)?
options: They had never travelled outside their home country before that European tour.
His eyes were strained because he had been staring at computer screens for hours.
By the year 2010, the company had been owning three major factories.
I had finished my essay yesterday at three o'clock precisely.
questions.explanation: Les propositions 1 et 2 sont parfaites (expérience antérieure et activité continue expliquant un état passé). Le verbe 'own' est statif (refuse -ING) et une heure ponctuelle simple comme 'yesterday at three' appelle le prétérit.

quizzes.title: Prétérit vs Present Perfect

questions.question: The aerospace company ... its first commercial satellite in 1997.
questions.explanation: L'année 1997 est une date passée totalement révolue et sans lien direct avec le présent : le prétérit simple est requis.

questions.question: Look at the mess! Someone ... the laboratory glassware, and shards are everywhere.
questions.explanation: Le Present Perfect s'emploie quand une action passée a une conséquence directe et visible dans la situation présente ('Look!').

questions.question: Over the course of her career, Dr Edwards ... numerous Nobel laureates.
questions.explanation: Pour évoquer l'expérience d'une personne vivante au cours d'une période non clôturée, on utilise le Present Perfect.

questions.question: Albert Einstein ... his theory of general relativity in 1915.
questions.explanation: Pour une personnalité historique décédée et un événement daté, le prétérit simple est obligatoire.

questions.question: I ... three emails this morning. (Note: it is currently 10:30 AM, still morning).
questions.explanation: Si la période de temps ('this morning') n'est pas encore terminée au moment où l'on parle, on emploie le Present Perfect.

questions.question: I ... three emails this morning. (Note: it is currently 4:00 PM, now afternoon).
questions.explanation: Si la matinée est achevée au moment où l'on s'exprime ('it is 4 PM'), la période est close : le prétérit simple est requis.

questions.question: How long ... in Edinburgh before you decided to relocate to Bristol?
questions.explanation: Le séjour à Édimbourg étant entièrement révolu avant le déménagement, on utilise 'did you live' (prétérit).

questions.question: How long ... in Edinburgh? — Since 2019, and I still thoroughly enjoy living here.
questions.explanation: L'action ayant commencé dans le passé et se poursuivant dans le présent ('I still enjoy living here'), le Present Perfect est incontournable.

questions.question: Did you watch the documentary about climate change last night? — Yes, I ... it with my family.
questions.explanation: La question porte sur un moment précis et révolu ('last night'), la réponse reste donc au prétérit simple.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly use the Present Perfect to indicate relevance to the present moment?
options: Astronomers have identified an exoplanet that could potentially harbour liquid water.
I have misplaced my laboratory pass, so I cannot enter the research wing right now.
The delegates have signed the international treaty three years ago.
She has won the gold medal during the 2012 London Olympic Games.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 créent un pont direct avec l'actualité présente. Les options 3 et 4 comportent des repères temporels révolus ('three years ago', 'during the 2012 Games') incompatibles avec le Present Perfect.

quizzes.title: Habitudes et états passés : Used to et Would

questions.question: My grandfather ... a vintage motorcycle dealership in the late 1980s.
questions.explanation: 'Used to' peut s'appliquer à des états passés permanents (verbes statifs comme 'own', 'be', 'have'), alors que 'would' ne s'applique qu'à des actions répétées.

questions.question: During the holidays, my grandmother ... bake fresh apple tarts every Sunday morning.
questions.explanation: 'Would' sert à décrire une action ou un rituel récurrent dans le passé, souvent teinté d'une nuance nostalgique.

questions.question: She ... appreciate modern poetry, but now she reads it enthusiastically.
questions.explanation: La forme négative standard d'une habitude passée est 'didn't use to + base verbale'.

questions.question: Where ... spend your summer vacations when you were a teenager?
questions.explanation: À la forme interrogative avec l'auxiliaire 'did', on écrit 'use to' avec la base verbale 'use' sans 'd'.

questions.question: Our former maths teacher ... live right next to the school campus.
questions.explanation: Le verbe 'live' exprime un état et non une action ponctuelle répétée : on doit employer 'used to' et non 'would'.

questions.question: Moving to London was bewildering at first, but she is gradually getting used to ... on the left.
questions.explanation: La structure 'get used to' signifie 's'habituer à' et est obligatoirement suivie d'un groupe nominal ou d'un verbe en -ING.

questions.question: He used to smoke twenty cigarettes a day, but he ... two years ago.
questions.explanation: Une rupture définitive et ponctuelle avec une habitude passée s'exprime au prétérit simple ('quit').

questions.question: Whenever we encountered a setback, our mentor ... encourage us with quiet optimism.
questions.explanation: 'Would' s'emploie couramment après une proposition subordonnée temporelle en 'whenever' pour exprimer une réaction coutumière passée.

questions.question: Why is the sentence 'He would be a teacher for ten years' incorrect?
options: 'Would' cannot express a state or a duration of state in the past.
'Would' can only be used with third-person singular pronouns.
'Would' requires the passive voice when describing professions.
'Would' cannot be followed by the base verb 'be'.
questions.explanation: 'Would' exprime des actions dynamiques répétées, jamais un état prolongé ou statif comme une profession occupée pendant dix ans.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly express past habits or former states?
options: We used to wander through the ancient woods for hours every autumn.
In the evenings, my father would sit by the fireplace and read historical novels.
She would have long curly hair when she was attending primary school.
Did you used to play chess with your grandfather at weekends?
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 sont parfaitement régulières. L'option 3 utilise à tort 'would' avec un verbe d'état ('have long hair'), et l'option 4 commet la faute 'did you used to' au lieu de 'did you use to'.

quizzes.title: Modaux de déduction au passé

questions.question: The cobblestones are soaking wet this morning; it ... heavily during the night.
questions.explanation: 'Must have + participe passé' traduit une quasi-certitude logique ou une déduction quasi certaine sur un fait passé ('il a sûrement plu').

questions.question: The suspect ... the burglary in London because airport logs prove he was in Tokyo that night.
questions.explanation: L'impossibilité logique ou la certitude négative au passé s'exprime par 'can't have + participe passé' (et non 'mustn't have').

questions.question: Where is Arthur? — I am not entirely certain; he ... the wrong connecting train.
questions.explanation: 'Might have' ou 'may have' expriment une éventualité ou une supposition non vérifiée sur un événement passé ('il se peut qu'il ait pris').

questions.question: Her briefcase and coat are still on the armchair, so she ... the building yet.
questions.explanation: La présence du manteau et de la sacoche constitue la preuve matérielle qu'elle ne peut pas être partie ('can't have left').

questions.question: You drove far too fast around that icy bend! You ... serious injuries to pedestrians.
questions.explanation: 'Could have + participe passé' sert à exprimer une possibilité théorique passée qui ne s'est heureusement pas réalisée ('tu aurais pu causer').

questions.question: Julian ... about the appointment; he had highlighted it in his daily planner.
questions.explanation: 'Couldn't have' exprime une certitude d'impossibilité : l'agenda surligné prouve qu'il ne peut pas avoir oublié.

questions.question: Archaeologists hypothesise that the ancient settlement ... abandoned due to catastrophic drought.
questions.explanation: Pour une hypothèse scientifique prudente sur le passé, 'may have been' ('il se peut qu'elle ait été...') est particulièrement adapté.

questions.question: The encrypted folder ... accidentally deleted during the routine server migration.
questions.explanation: À la voix passive, le modal de déduction passé s'associe à 'been' : 'must have been deleted'.

questions.question: Because her vehicle broke down on the motorway, she ... hail a taxi.
questions.explanation: Il s'agit ici d'une obligation concrète passée (et non d'une déduction) : on emploie 'had to' comme prétérit de l'obligation.

questions.question: Which sentences express a logical deduction or conjecture regarding a past event?
options: The scientific team must have worked relentlessly to achieve such a breakthrough.
The eyewitness might have mistaken the vehicle model in the darkness.
Candidates had to submit their dissertations before midnight yesterday.
She must present her identification documents at the security desk right now.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 contiennent des modaux de déduction/conjecture rétrospective ('must have', 'might have'). L'option 3 exprime une obligation passée et l'option 4 une obligation présente.

quizzes.title: Regrets, reproches et modaux au passé

questions.question: You ... me that the meeting was postponed! I waited outside the boardroom for an hour.
questions.explanation: 'Should have + participe passé' exprime un reproche ou un devoir passé non accompli ('tu aurais dû me prévenir').

questions.question: You ... all those groceries; the refrigerator was already completely stocked!
questions.explanation: 'Needn't have + participe passé' indique qu'une action a été effectuée dans le passé alors qu'elle s'est avérée inutile après coup.

questions.question: Because the conference was cancelled well in advance, we ... early to catch the train.
questions.explanation: 'Didn't need to + base verbale' indique que l'action n'était pas nécessaire et n'a par conséquent pas été accomplie.

questions.question: He was gifted in mathematics; he ... a financial analyst, but he chose theatre instead.
questions.explanation: 'Could have become' exprime une opportunité ou un potentiel passé qui n'a pas été concrétisé ('il aurait pu devenir').

questions.question: I have an awful stomach ache now; I ... that entire box of chocolates.
questions.explanation: 'Shouldn't have + participe passé' traduit un regret personnel direct sur un comportement passé.

questions.question: You ... the front gate unlocked all weekend! An intruder could have slipped in.
questions.explanation: 'Ought not to have + participe passé' est l'équivalent soutenu de 'shouldn't have' pour exprimer un reproche formel.

questions.question: If our team had possessed the necessary funds, we ... the project without delay.
questions.explanation: Dans la proposition principale du 3e conditionnel (irréel du passé), la structure est 'would have + participe passé'.

questions.question: What does 'She needn't have brought an umbrella' strictly imply?
options: She didn't bring an umbrella because it was sunny.
She brought an umbrella, but it did not rain.
She forgot her umbrella at home.
She was forbidden from carrying an umbrella.
questions.explanation: 'Needn't have brought' prouve qu'elle a effectivement emporté un parapluie, geste qui s'est avéré inutile car la pluie n'est pas tombée.

questions.question: The engine had flooded with fuel, and the boat ... start despite our best efforts.
questions.explanation: 'Wouldn't' au passé traduit un refus obstiné d'un être animé ou un dysfonctionnement répété d'un mécanisme ('le moteur refusait de démarrer').

questions.question: Which sentences express a past regret, criticism, or unfulfilled opportunity?
options: You ought to have alerted the laboratory supervisor as soon as the spill occurred.
I could have accepted the overseas scholarship, but family obligations kept me home.
They must have misplaced the cryptographic key during the relocation.
The visitors had to vacate the gallery precisely when closing time was announced.
questions.explanation: La phrase 1 formule un reproche ('ought to have alerted') et la phrase 2 une opportunité manquée ('could have accepted'). L'option 3 est une déduction et l'option 4 une obligation institutionnelle passée.

quizzes.title: Le discours indirect et la concordance des temps

questions.question: "I live in central Belfast," she stated. -> She stated that she ... in central Belfast.
questions.explanation: Au discours indirect introduit par un verbe au prétérit ('stated'), le présent simple subit un recul temporel (backshift) vers le prétérit simple.

questions.question: "We are testing a new prototype," the engineers declared. -> They declared that they ... a new prototype.
questions.explanation: Le présent continu ('are testing') devient un prétérit continu ('were testing') après un verbe introducteur au passé.

questions.question: "I visited the Roman ruins yesterday," Mark said. -> Mark said that he ... the Roman ruins the previous day.
questions.explanation: Le prétérit simple au discours direct ('visited') recule au Past Perfect ('had visited') au discours indirect.

questions.question: "I will deliver the lecture tomorrow," Professor Thorne announced. -> He announced that he ... deliver the lecture the following day.
questions.explanation: Le modal 'will' du futur bascule au conditionnel 'would' en concordance avec le verbe introducteur au passé.

questions.question: "I can decipher this ancient script," the linguist remarked. -> The linguist remarked that she ... decipher the script.
questions.explanation: Le modal de capacité 'can' recule à 'could' au discours indirect au passé.

questions.question: "You must wear protective headgear," the foreman told us. -> The foreman told us that we ... wear protective headgear.
questions.explanation: Le modal d'obligation 'must' devient généralement 'had to' au discours indirect lorsqu'il s'agit d'un ordre passé.

questions.question: "Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius," the physics tutor explained. -> The tutor explained that water ... at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: Lorsqu'une déclaration exprime une vérité scientifique immuable ou une loi de la nature, le présent de vérité générale ('boils') est conservé sans recul temporel.

questions.question: In reported speech, the time indicator 'yesterday' is regularly converted into:
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' se transforme en 'the day before' ou 'the previous day' pour respecter la déictique du discours indirect.

questions.question: "Where did you hide the manuscripts?" he asked me. -> He asked me where I ... the manuscripts.
questions.explanation: Dans une interrogation indirecte, l'ordre des mots redevient sujet + verbe (pas d'inversion auxiliaire) et le prétérit simple recule au Past Perfect ('had hidden').

questions.question: Which sentences demonstrate correct tense backshift in reported speech?
options: The ambassador reported that the peace summit had collapsed the previous evening.
The spokesperson confirmed that bilateral trade talks would resume the following month.
She asked the clerk where did he store the confidential files.
The meteorologist stated that it will snow yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 appliquent scrupuleusement la concordance des temps et les marqueurs adaptés. L'option 3 conserve à tort l'inversion de question directe ('where did he store'), et l'option 4 associe absurdement 'will' et 'yesterday'.

quizzes.title: La voix passive aux temps du passé

questions.question: The iconic suspension bridge ... in 1937 after four years of intensive construction.
questions.explanation: La voix passive au prétérit simple se forme avec l'auxiliaire 'was/were' suivi du participe passé : 'was built'.

questions.question: When we stepped into the auditorium, the lighting rig ... by the stage crew.
questions.explanation: Le passif au prétérit continu s'écrit 'was/were being + participe passé' pour souligner une action passive en cours d'exécution.

questions.question: All the emergency protocols ... before the simulation officially began.
questions.explanation: Le passif au Past Perfect ('had been + participe passé') marque l'antériorité de l'action passive par rapport au début de la simulation.

questions.question: The classified blueprints ... in a fireproof vault, but they were left on a desk.
questions.explanation: Un reproche passif au passé se construit avec 'should have been + participe passé'.

questions.question: Several ancient gold coins ... during the dredging of the river bed.
questions.explanation: Le sujet 'Several ancient gold coins' est au pluriel, l'auxiliaire s'accorde donc : 'were discovered'.

questions.question: When ... the Magna Carta signed by King John at Runnymede?
questions.explanation: À la forme interrogative passive au prétérit, l'auxiliaire 'was' précède le sujet singulier 'the Magna Carta'.

questions.question: In the nineteenth century, it ... that microscopic germs caused epidemics.
questions.explanation: La tournure passive impersonnelle au passé 'It was believed that...' permet d'exprimer une opinion collective d'époque.

questions.question: After the hurricane ripped our roof shingles, we had the roof ... by local roofers.
questions.explanation: La structure causative 'have something done' au passé demande un participe passé : 'we had the roof repaired'.

questions.question: The hostages ... in an underground bunker when tactical units breached the perimeter.
questions.explanation: Pour insister sur la détention passive en cours au moment précis de l'assaut, le passif progressif ('were being held') est parfait.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly feature a past passive construction?
options: The medieval cathedral was meticulously restored after the fire of 1994.
The research archives had been catalogued prior to the university's centenary.
The suspect was being interrogate by three senior detectives all night.
All the tickets were sold out before the concert has begun.
questions.explanation: Les options 1 et 2 sont d'authentiques passifs passés bien construits ('was restored', 'had been catalogued'). L'option 3 oublie le participe passé ('interrogated'), et l'option 4 mélange un passé révolu avec un 'has begun' inapproprié.

quizzes.title: Inversions stylistiques et narration soutenue

questions.question: Hardly ... the laboratory when the emergency alarms began ringing loudly.
questions.explanation: Après un adverbe négatif ou restrictif comme 'Hardly', on opère une inversion sujet-auxiliaire au Past Perfect : 'Hardly had the scientist entered... when'.

questions.question: No sooner had the prime minister concluded his address ... the journalists raised their hands.
questions.explanation: La corrélation comparative de 'No sooner had...' s'associe obligatoirement avec 'than' (et non 'when').

questions.question: Scarcely had the explorers established camp ... a ferocious blizzard engulfed the plateau.
questions.explanation: 'Scarcely had...' s'associe classiquement avec la conjonction 'when' pour marquer l'immédiateté de la seconde action.

questions.question: Little ... that their scientific discovery would trigger a worldwide industrial revolution.
questions.explanation: 'Little did + sujet + base verbale' est la structure d'inversion consacrée pour signifier 'ils étaient bien loin de se douter que'.

questions.question: Seldom ... such extraordinary resilience displayed by an entire civilian population.
questions.explanation: Placé en tête de phrase pour un effet stylistique emphatique, 'Seldom' déclenche l'inversion auxiliaire-sujet : 'had the world witnessed'.

questions.question: Not until dawn broke ... the catastrophic extent of the flood damage.
questions.explanation: Avec 'Not until...', l'inversion sujet-auxiliaire porte sur la proposition principale : 'did the villagers realise'.

questions.question: Only after examining the encrypted ledger ... the detective fathom the financial conspiracy.
questions.explanation: 'Only after + V-ing' entraîne l'inversion dans la proposition principale avec l'auxiliaire 'did' : 'did the detective fathom'.

questions.question: Under no circumstances ... permitted to leave the examination hall unchaperoned.
questions.explanation: L'expression restrictive 'Under no circumstances' placée en tête impose l'inversion de l'auxiliaire passif : 'were the candidates permitted'.

questions.question: Through the heavy morning fog ... a mysterious carriage drawn by black stallions.
questions.explanation: Dans un style narratif littéraire, après un complément circonstanciel de lieu en tête de phrase, le verbe complet précède directement le sujet ('emerged a mysterious carriage').

questions.question: Which sentences correctly feature literary negative inversion in a past narrative?
options: No sooner had the curtain fallen than the packed auditorium erupted into cheers.
Rarely had the kingdom experienced such a prolonged period of political harmony.
Hardly the train had pulled out when the emergency brakes slammed on.
Scarcely had she finished speaking than everyone started shouting at once.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 sont irréprochables ('No sooner had... than', 'Rarely had...'). L'option 3 omet l'inversion ('Hardly the train had...'), et l'option 4 associe à tort 'Scarcely' avec 'than' au lieu de 'when'.

quizzes.title: Bilan narratif : Maîtriser le récit au passé

questions.question: She turned the key in the ignition, stepped on the accelerator, and ... down the deserted road.
questions.explanation: Pour une série d'actions consécutives et rapides constituant la trame narrative principale, le prétérit simple ('sped') s'impose.

questions.question: If the medical team ... the antibiotic immediately, the patient's condition would not have deteriorated.
questions.explanation: Dans la proposition conditionnelle en 'if' d'un 3e conditionnel (irréel du passé), on emploie le Past Perfect ('had administered').

questions.question: If they had checked the train timetable, they ... the final connection to Edinburgh.
questions.explanation: La conséquence passée hypothétique non réalisée se construit avec 'would have + participe passé' : 'wouldn't have missed'.

questions.question: I deeply regret losing my composure; I truly wish I ... at the referee.
questions.explanation: Après 'wish', pour exprimer un regret portant sur un fait passé révolu, on emploie le Past Perfect modal ('hadn't shouted').

questions.question: He described the ancient Amazonian temples as if he ... there himself.
questions.explanation: Après 'as if / as though', pour désigner une situation passée imaginaire ou non vécue, on utilise le Past Perfect ('had been').

questions.question: While the family ... dinner, the father realised he ... to lock the front gate.
questions.explanation: L'action continue en cours est au prétérit en BE + -ING ('were having'), tandis que l'oubli antérieur à la prise de conscience est au Past Perfect ('had forgotten').

questions.question: ... the authorities anticipated the hurricane's trajectory, the evacuation would have run smoothly.
questions.explanation: Dans un registre soutenu, on peut omettre 'if' dans un 3e conditionnel en inversant le sujet et l'auxiliaire 'Had' : 'Had the authorities anticipated...'.

questions.question: I ... to attend the gala, but an unforeseen family emergency prevented me.
questions.explanation: Le Past Perfect avec des verbes comme 'intend', 'hope' ou 'plan' exprime une intention passée qui n'a finalement pas pu aboutir.

questions.question: The Titanic sank barely three hours after it ... the submerged iceberg.
questions.explanation: La collision avec l'iceberg ayant précédé le naufrage, le Past Perfect ('had struck') explicite l'antériorité chronologique.

questions.question: Which sentences accurately convey complex temporal relationships in a past narrative?
options: Having completed her doctoral dissertation, Dr Vance booked a celebratory holiday to Iceland.
Had the warning signs been heeded earlier, the catastrophic dam failure could have been averted.
He was walking down the dimly lit alley when he was noticing a sinister silhouette.
By the time the search party reached the peak, the blizzard will have subsided.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 (participe parfait 'Having completed') et 2 (conditionnel inversé sans 'if') sont remarquables de précision. L'option 3 utilise à tort un aspect progressif pour un verbe de perception ponctuelle ('notice'), et l'option 4 commet un anachronisme avec 'will have'.

quizzes.title: For, Since et Ago

questions.question: The historic peace treaty was ratified more than two centuries ... by the founding assembly.
questions.explanation: 'Ago' se place toujours après une durée pour calculer un recul temporel par rapport au présent, et s'emploie avec le prétérit simple.

questions.question: Private investment in renewable energy has expanded rapidly ... the 2015 Paris Agreement.
questions.explanation: 'Since' s'emploie avec un point de départ précis dans le temps (ici l'accord de 2015) et appelle un Present Perfect dans la principale.

questions.question: The civil rights marchers walked courageously through torrential rain ... five consecutive days.
questions.explanation: 'For' introduit une durée mesurable ('five consecutive days'), qu'elle soit révolue (avec le prétérit) ou continue.

questions.question: Professor Higgins has published four groundbreaking monographs since he ... the department in 2012.
questions.explanation: Dans une subordonnée introduite par 'since', l'événement servant de point de repère temporel initial est au prétérit simple ('joined').

questions.question: How long ago ... the declaration of human rights signed by the assembly?
questions.explanation: Une question débutant par 'How long ago...' porte sur une date passée précise et exige impérativement le prétérit simple.

questions.question: The Roman legions maintained control over Britannia ... nearly four hundred years.
questions.explanation: Pour exprimer la durée totale d'un événement historique achevé, on emploie 'for' associé à un verbe au prétérit simple.

questions.question: She won the international piano competition in 2018, and ... she has toured worldwide.
questions.explanation: 'Since then' (ou 'ever since') signifie 'depuis lors' et fait référence à un événement passé en liant la période au présent.

questions.question: What is the core grammatical difference between 'for' and 'since'?
options: 'For' indicates a duration of time, while 'since' marks a specific starting point.
'For' can only be used with the future tense, while 'since' is strictly past.
'Since' is always followed by an -ING form, while 'for' requires a noun.
'For' is exclusively used for people, while 'since' is used for events.
questions.explanation: 'For' quantifie la durée globale (combien de temps), alors que 'since' ancre le point de départ d'une action ininterrompue (depuis quand).

questions.question: When peace was declared, the displaced families ... in makeshift refugee camps for six long years.
questions.explanation: La durée s'étalant jusqu'à un repère passé ('When peace was declared'), on associe 'for' au Past Perfect continu.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly utilize 'for', 'since', or 'ago'?
options: The scientific laboratory was inaugurated three decades ago by the ministry.
She has been conducting botanical research since she completed her doctorate.
They arrived at the international terminal since two hours ago.
He lived in Montreal since ten years before moving to Vancouver.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 ('three decades ago') et 2 ('since she completed...') sont parfaitement correctes. L'option 3 cumule à tort 'since' et 'ago', et l'option 4 utilise 'since' au lieu de 'for' devant une durée ('for ten years').

quizzes.title: Already, Yet, Still et Just

questions.question: The passengers have ... touched down at Heathrow; their flight landed three minutes ago.
questions.explanation: 'Just' placé entre l'auxiliaire et le participe passé indique qu'une action vient tout juste d'avoir lieu.

questions.question: The clinical trial committee has not published its final peer-reviewed findings ... .
questions.explanation: 'Yet' se place en fin de proposition négative pour signifier 'pas encore' ('has not published... yet').

questions.question: Have you completed that complex biochemical analysis ... ? That was remarkably quick!
questions.explanation: Dans une question, 'already' exprime la surprise face à une action accomplie plus tôt que prévu.

questions.question: Despite three rounds of arbitration, the two rival corporations ... disputed patent ownership.
questions.explanation: 'Still' exprime la persistance ou la continuité d'un état ou d'une action ('ils contestaient toujours/encore').

questions.question: In American English narrative prose, it is common to hear: "I ... finished my breakfast, so I'm not hungry."
questions.explanation: En anglais américain, 'just' est très couramment employé avec le prétérit simple ('I just finished') pour une action immédiate.

questions.question: By 10 PM, the disaster management team had ... evacuated over two thousand citizens.
questions.explanation: 'Already' insiste sur l'accomplissement effectif de l'action avant le repère temporel passé ('had already evacuated').

questions.question: Although the deadline expired yesterday, the candidate ... has not submitted his credentials.
questions.explanation: Placé devant un auxiliaire négatif ('still has not'), 'still' souligne l'étonnement ou l'agacement devant une action qui tarde.

questions.question: Has the diplomatic delegation arrived at the embassy ... ?
questions.explanation: Dans une question neutre visant à vérifier si une action a eu lieu ou non, 'yet' se place en fin de phrase.

questions.question: The lecture had ... begun when a sudden power outage plunged the hall into pitch darkness.
questions.explanation: 'Had just + participe passé' traduit le fait que l'événement venait à peine de commencer quand l'interruption a eu lieu.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly position 'already', 'yet', 'still', or 'just'?
options: The scientific team has already gathered sufficient telemetry data to test the hypothesis.
The board of directors has not reached a consensus on the proposed budget yet.
She has submitted yet her doctoral application before the deadline.
He still have not understood the legal implications of the contract.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 placent impeccablement 'already' (milieu de phrase) et 'yet' (fin de négation). L'option 3 place 'yet' de façon incorrecte, et l'option 4 commet une faute d'accord ('he still have').

quizzes.title: Connecteurs temporels narratifs

questions.question: The field researchers collected soil samples; ..., the laboratory technicians prepared reagents.
questions.explanation: 'Meanwhile' signifie 'pendant ce temps / parallèlement' et relie deux actions qui se déroulent simultanément dans des lieux différents.

questions.question: The sprinters exploded from the starting blocks ... the pistol fired.
questions.explanation: 'As soon as' exprime l'immédiateté d'une réaction dès que l'élément déclencheur se produit.

questions.question: The night guards stood vigilant at the castle gate ... relief forces arrived at daybreak.
questions.explanation: 'Until' (jusqu'à ce que) marque la limite temporelle marquant la fin de l'état ou de l'activité passée.

questions.question: The driver fell asleep at the wheel ... he was cruising along the empty highway.
questions.explanation: 'While' introduit une proposition décrivant une action continue pendant laquelle un événement soudain survient.

questions.question: After months of rigorous investigative journalism, the reporters ... uncovered the truth.
questions.explanation: 'Eventually' signifie 'finalement / au bout du compte' (et non 'éventuellement' qui est un faux-ami signifiant 'possibly').

questions.question: The main course will take forty minutes to roast; ..., let us serve the appetizers.
questions.explanation: 'In the meantime' est un synonyme de 'meanwhile', parfait pour introduire une action intercalaire.

questions.question: The keynote speaker had no sooner stepped onto the rostrum ... the audiovisual feed failed.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner... than' forme une paire corrélative inséparable pour signifier 'à peine... que'.

questions.question: The civilian population endured immense food shortages ... the catastrophic winter of 1944.
questions.explanation: 'Throughout' insiste sur la totalité continue d'une période temporelle ('tout au long de / d'un bout à l'autre de').

questions.question: ... the commander entered the briefing room, all subordinate officers rose to their feet.
questions.explanation: 'Whenever' (chaque fois que) souligne le caractère systématique d'une action à chaque répétition dans le passé.

questions.question: Which narrative sentences use temporal connectors appropriately?
options: The detectives secured the perimeter while forensic specialists gathered fingerprints.
The stranded climbers sheltered in a snow cave until the rescue helicopter spotted them.
He waited in the lobby meanwhile she was attending the interview.
As soon as the siren sounded, the factory workers were leaving immediately the building.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 emploient adéquatement 'while' et 'until'. L'option 3 utilise fautivement 'meanwhile' comme une conjonction de subordination (au lieu de 'while'), et l'option 4 place mal l'adverbe et le temps verbal.

quizzes.title: Ever, Never et fréquences temporelles

questions.question: Did you ... witness a total solar eclipse during your travels across South America?
questions.explanation: 'Ever' s'emploie dans les interrogations pour signifier 'déjà / jamais au cours de ta vie' ('Did you ever witness...?').

questions.question: That archaeological expedition was the most perilous mission the team had ... undertaken.
questions.explanation: Après un superlatif ('the most perilous mission') combiné au Past Perfect, on emploie 'ever' pour exprimer 'jamais auparavant'.

questions.question: Prior to that Atlantic crossing, the young sailor had ... steered a vessel through stormy seas.
questions.explanation: 'Never' s'associe au Past Perfect pour souligner l'absence totale d'expérience antérieure avant un point donné du passé.

questions.question: During the Great Depression, impoverished households ... consumed fresh meat.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly ever' signifie 'presque jamais' et s'emploie sans double négation.

questions.question: Never before ... such collective courage in the face of unprecedented adversity.
questions.explanation: La locution 'Never before' en début de phrase impose l'inversion stylistique auxiliaire-sujet : 'had the world seen'.

questions.question: The two scholars met at Cambridge in 2011 and have collaborated ... .
questions.explanation: 'Ever since' signifie 'depuis ce jour-là sans interruption' et s'associe idéalement avec le Present Perfect.

questions.question: The veteran pilot ... checked the oil pressure gauges before commencing takeoff.
questions.explanation: Les adverbes de fréquence simples comme 'always' se placent directement avant le verbe lexical conjugué au prétérit simple ('always checked').

questions.question: In ancient Sparta, citizens ... questioned the absolute authority of the elders.
questions.explanation: 'Scarcely ever' est une expression soutenue signifiant 'presque jamais' qui ne tolère aucune particule négative additionnelle.

questions.question: It was the first time in his life that he ... experienced genuine stage fright.
questions.explanation: La formule 'It was the first time that...' transposée au passé commande 'had ever + participe passé'.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly employ frequency and polarity adverbs like 'ever' or 'never'?
options: Never had the nation witnessed such extraordinary political mobilization.
It was the most challenging mountain ascent the climbers had ever completed.
He didn't never divulge the confidential laboratory formula to outsiders.
Have you ever went to Shakespeare's birthplace in Stratford-upon-Avon?
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 sont parfaites. L'option 3 présente une double négation prohibée en anglais standard ('didn't never'), et l'option 4 utilise à tort le prétérit 'went' au lieu du participe passé 'been' ou 'gone'.

quizzes.title: By the time, Before et After

questions.question: By the time the fire engines reached the factory, the warehouse roof ... in.
questions.explanation: Dans une proposition principale subordonnée à 'By the time + prétérit', l'action déjà accomplie se met au Past Perfect ('had caved').

questions.question: Before ... the commercial lease, the company's attorney inspected every single clause.
questions.explanation: Après une préposition comme 'before', le verbe prend obligatoirement la forme en -ING ('before signing').

questions.question: After the jurors ... all the forensic evidence, they delivered a unanimous guilty verdict.
questions.explanation: L'examen des preuves ayant précédé le verdict, l'antériorité est soulignée par le Past Perfect ('had examined').

questions.question: Compare: "By the time you wake up tomorrow morning, my train ... Edinburgh."
questions.explanation: Attention au contraste : si 'by the time' renvoie à un moment futur, la principale se met au futur antérieur ('will have reached').

questions.question: The navigator had reviewed the maritime charts meticulously ... setting sail across the ocean.
questions.explanation: L'action antérieure ('had reviewed') s'est déroulée en amont du départ en mer ('before setting sail').

questions.question: After ... the summit of Mount Everest, the mountaineers took commemorative photographs.
questions.explanation: 'After having reached' (participe parfait composé) met clairement en valeur l'achèvement préalable de l'ascension.

questions.question: The train had pulled out of the platform just seconds before we ... into the station.
questions.explanation: La proposition subordonnée introduite par 'before' se conjugue au prétérit simple ('dashed') pour servir de point de repère temporel.

questions.question: By the end of the nineteenth century, steam-powered locomotives ... continental trade.
questions.explanation: 'By + date passée' fixe une échéance temporelle révolue qui appelle le Past Perfect.

questions.question: The historical archives were not opened to researchers until the cataloguing ... completed.
questions.explanation: L'achèvement du catalogage étant la condition préalable à l'ouverture passée des archives, le Past Perfect passif s'impose.

questions.question: Which sentences accurately sequence events using 'by the time', 'before', or 'after'?
options: By the time the paramedics arrived, civilian bystanders had administered cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
After the detectives had secured the crime scene, forensic specialists dusted for fingerprints.
By the time he arrived at the station yesterday, the express train will have already left.
Before to sign the diplomatic treaty, both heads of state conferred in private.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 respectent parfaitement la hiérarchie des temps du passé. L'option 3 associe à tort un repère passé ('yesterday') à un futur antérieur ('will have left'), et l'option 4 utilise 'Before to sign' au lieu de 'Before signing'.

quizzes.title: During, While et For

questions.question: Several guests felt uncomfortably warm ... the two-hour university graduation ceremony.
questions.explanation: 'During' est une préposition suivie d'un groupe nominal ('the ceremony') indiquant l'époque ou le créneau au cours duquel l'action se produit.

questions.question: The telephone rang persistently three times ... I was taking a hot shower.
questions.explanation: 'While' est une conjonction de subordination introduisant une proposition complète avec sujet et verbe ('I was taking').

questions.question: The stranded arctic researchers had to ration their biscuits ... nearly a fortnight.
questions.explanation: 'For' est requis devant une expression de durée quantifiable ('nearly a fortnight').

questions.question: Why is the clause "during I was revising my chemistry notes" ungrammatical in English?
options: 'During' cannot be used with first-person singular subjects.
'During' is only used to refer to military conflicts.
'During' must be accompanied by the auxiliary verb 'do'.
'During' is a preposition followed by a noun phrase, never by a clause with a verb.
questions.explanation: 'During' ne peut jamais introduire une proposition subordonnée avec verbe conjugué : on doit employer 'while' ('while I was revising').

questions.question: ... wandering through the historic quarter, the tourists stumbled upon an artisan workshop.
questions.explanation: 'While' peut être suivi directement d'un participe présent en -ING ('While wandering...'), contrairement à 'during'.

questions.question: Strict blackouts and curfew measures were enforced across London ... the Blitz.
questions.explanation: 'The Blitz' est un événement nominalisé : on emploie 'during the Blitz'.

questions.question: The programmer stayed awake ... thirty-six consecutive hours to debug the core application.
questions.explanation: 'Thirty-six consecutive hours' exprime une durée mesurée : la préposition 'for' est indispensable.

questions.question: ... the theatre curtain slowly rose, the orchestra struck up the opening overture.
questions.explanation: 'As' s'emploie pour marquer une stricte simultanéité d'évolution entre deux actions de courte durée.

questions.question: Inflation rates escalated sharply ... the global oil embargo of 1973.
questions.explanation: 'The global oil embargo of 1973' est un groupe nominal désignant un événement historique : on emploie 'during'.

questions.question: Which sentences respect the correct grammatical usage of 'during', 'while', and 'for'?
options: The power grid failed during the violent thunderstorm that struck the valley.
While listening to the audio recording, the translator transcribed key statements.
During we were hiking in the national park, we observed a pack of wolves.
She has been waiting outside in the rain during twenty-five minutes.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 ('during the thunderstorm') et 2 ('While listening') sont parfaitement conformes. L'option 3 utilise fautivement 'during' devant une proposition sujet+verbe ('during we were'), et l'option 4 emploie 'during' au lieu de 'for' devant une durée.

quizzes.title: Structures temporelles avec Once, As et When

questions.question: Once the peace protocol ... signed by all belligerent parties, humanitarian convoys entered.
questions.explanation: 'Once' (une fois que) introduit une condition temporelle réalisée : dans un récit au passé, elle prend le prétérit simple (ou Past Perfect).

questions.question: As the sun gradually ... below the horizon, temperatures plunged below freezing point.
questions.explanation: 'As' traduit ici la simultanéité progressive entre deux évolutions parallèles dans le passé au prétérit simple.

questions.question: We were enjoying a quiet stroll in the orchard when suddenly a fierce storm ... .
questions.explanation: 'When' introduit l'événement soudain et ponctuel au prétérit simple qui vient interrompre l'action continue en cours.

questions.question: Once the lead investigator ... all the witness statements, she drafted her official report.
questions.explanation: L'action de rassembler les dépositions étant totalement close avant la rédaction, le Past Perfect ('had gathered') marque la complétude.

questions.question: When the foreign dignitary ... into the plenary chamber, the delegates applauded warmly.
questions.explanation: L'entrée dans la salle est un fait ponctuel qui déclenche immédiatement les applaudissements : prétérit simple.

questions.question: As the weeks ... by, the stranded sailors became increasingly despondent.
questions.explanation: 'As the weeks went by' est une tournure idiomatique consacrée pour traduire le passage inexorable du temps au fil du récit.

questions.question: Which temporal conjunction is best suited to introduce an abrupt interruption in a narrative?
questions.explanation: 'When' est la conjonction par excellence introduisant l'incident inattendu qui coupe une action en cours ('I was sleeping when...').

questions.question: Just as the express train was departing, an out-of-breath traveller ... onto the carriage step.
questions.explanation: 'Just as' marque une coïncidence temporelle exacte entre une action en cours et un bond soudain au prétérit simple.

questions.question: Once ... by the master stonemasons, the cathedral facade regained its medieval splendour.
questions.explanation: 'Once restored' est une proposition participiale raccourcie élégante, équivalant à 'Once it had been restored'.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly connect past events using 'once', 'as', or 'when'?
options: Once the cryptographic key had been decoded, the intelligence agents intercepted the transmissions.
As the tempest intensified, lighthouse keepers reinforced the lower storm shutters.
When the teacher was entering the room, every single pupil stood up immediately.
Once the school bell was rang, the children rushed outdoors onto the playground.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 articulent rigoureusement les actions passées. L'option 3 emploie maladroitement un aspect progressif pour un acte instantané ('walked in'), et l'option 4 contient une faute de passif grossière ('was rang' au lieu de 'rang' ou 'had rung').

quizzes.title: Expressions temporelles idiomatiques du passé

questions.question: The prime minister's announcement to dissolve parliament came completely ... ; nobody had anticipated it.
questions.explanation: 'Out of the blue' est un idiome signifiant 'comme un coup de tonnerre dans un ciel bleu / tout à fait à l'improviste'.

questions.question: The rescuer grabbed the child's coat ..., just seconds before the icy ledge collapsed.
questions.explanation: 'In the nick of time' signifie 'juste à temps / au tout dernier moment in extremis'.

questions.question: Upon hearing the loud chemical alarm, the researchers evacuated the cleanroom ... .
questions.explanation: 'At once' signifie 'immédiatement / sur-le-champ'.

questions.question: ... , the twin engines sputtered, lost altitude rapidly, and cut out entirely.
questions.explanation: 'All of a sudden' signifie 'tout à coup / subitement' et introduit un incident dramatique dans un récit.

questions.question: Thanks to the newly installed optic fibre network, the archive downloaded ... .
questions.explanation: 'In no time (at all)' signifie 'en un rien de temps / en un clin d'œil'.

questions.question: The explorers pitched a temporary canvas tent ... until the snowstorm subsided.
questions.explanation: 'For the time being' signifie 'pour le moment / provisoirement'.

questions.question: While posted overseas, the diplomat wrote handwritten letters to his parents ... .
questions.explanation: 'From time to time' signifie 'de temps à autre / occasionnellement'.

questions.question: The supersonic jet accelerated and vanished beyond the cloud bank ... .
options: in the blink of an eye
questions.explanation: 'In the blink of an eye' signifie 'en un clin d'œil / en une fraction de seconde'.

questions.question: Ada Lovelace's early computational insights were disregarded because they were centuries ... .
questions.explanation: 'Ahead of one's time' est une expression consacrée signifiant 'en avance sur son temps / avant-gardiste'.

questions.question: Which sentences correctly utilize idiomatic time expressions in a past narrative context?
options: The flight surgeon arrived in the nick of time and successfully stabilized the patient.
Out of the blue, an anonymous philanthropist bequeathed five million pounds to the university.
All in a sudden, the power grid suffered a catastrophic cascade failure.
He completed the gruelling obstacle course at no time despite intense exhaustion.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 emploient parfaitement 'in the nick of time' et 'out of the blue'. L'option 3 commet l'erreur 'All in a sudden' (au lieu de 'All of a sudden'), et l'option 4 emploie fautivement 'at no time' au lieu de 'in no time'.

quizzes.title: It's (high) time et le prétérit modal

questions.question: It's high time the international community ... binding sanctions against rogue polluters.
questions.explanation: La structure 'It is (high/about) time + sujet' est obligatoirement suivie d'un prétérit modal exprimant l'urgence d'une action qui tarde ('took').

questions.question: It's about time you ... responsibility for your administrative blunders.
questions.explanation: 'It's about time + sujet' demande le prétérit modal ('accepted') pour signaler un reproche ou un retard.

questions.question: I would rather you ... me the plain truth right now instead of making excuses.
questions.explanation: Après 'would rather + sujet distinct', pour exprimer une préférence sur le présent ou l'avenir, on emploie le prétérit modal ('told').

questions.question: I would rather you ... that confidential email to the press yesterday.
questions.explanation: Après 'would rather + sujet distinct', pour exprimer un regret portant sur un fait passé révolu, on emploie le Past Perfect modal ('hadn't sent').

questions.question: It's time ... these bilateral negotiations and sign the accord.
questions.explanation: Quand 'It's time' n'est pas suivi d'un sujet grammatical, on emploie tout simplement l'infinitif complet avec 'to' ('to conclude').

questions.question: He pontificates about aeronautics as if he ... a certified aerospace engineer.
questions.explanation: Après 'as if / as though', on emploie le subjonctif passé (ou prétérit modal 'were' à toutes les personnes) pour marquer une contre-vérité présente.

questions.question: What is the exact grammatical function of 'left' in "It is high time we left"?
options: It describes an action that was finished yesterday.
It is a past continuous passive participle.
It is a modal preterite expressing urgency or unreality in the present.
It is a future imperative form.
questions.explanation: Le verbe 'left' est ici un prétérit modal : sa forme est passée mais sa valeur temporelle est présente, traduisant l'urgence d'agir.

questions.question: I wish the municipal council ... more public funds into community healthcare.
questions.explanation: Pour formuler un souhait irréalisé dans le présent avec 'wish', on utilise le prétérit modal ('allocated').

questions.question: The author wishes she ... that lucrative publishing contract last spring.
questions.explanation: Pour un regret rétrospectif portant sur une décision passée ('last spring'), 'wish' est suivi du Past Perfect modal ('had accepted').

questions.question: Which sentences correctly demonstrate the modal preterite or subjunctive-like past constructions?
options: It is high time the government addressed the critical shortage of affordable housing.
I would rather you hadn't mentioned our financial difficulties to the reporters.
It is about time that he starts taking his academic obligations seriously.
She wishes she has consulted an independent financial advisor before investing.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 et 2 illustrent parfaitement le prétérit modal ('addressed') et le regret passé après 'would rather' ('hadn't mentioned'). L'option 3 omet le prétérit modal après 'It is about time' ('starts' au lieu de 'started'), et l'option 4 commet l'erreur 'has consulted' au lieu de 'had consulted'.

quizzes.title: Bilan des marqueurs temporels

questions.question: Dr Watson had been living in Vienna ... five years when the political crisis erupted.
questions.explanation: Pour quantifier la durée d'une situation antérieure continue ('five years') avant un événement passé, on emploie 'for'.

questions.question: The ministry has not received any official correspondence from that embassy ... last November.
questions.explanation: 'Last November' est un point de départ temporel précis : la préposition adéquate est 'since'.

questions.question: The devastating tsunami struck the coastal settlements exactly two decades ... .
questions.explanation: Le calcul d'un recul temporel par rapport au présent ('two decades') associé à un verbe au prétérit simple ('struck') appelle 'ago'.

questions.question: By the time the rescue team reached the avalanche site, the blizzard ... all tracks.
questions.explanation: L'action d'effacer les traces étant antérieure à l'arrivée des secours, 'By the time + prétérit' réclame le Past Perfect ('had obscured').

questions.question: The intruder sneaked into the gallery ... the night guard was monitoring the monitors.
questions.explanation: Devant une proposition subordonnée avec sujet et verbe en BE + -ING, 'while' est la conjonction requise.

questions.question: The pharmaceuticals agency has not yet validated the clinical trial safety results ... .
questions.explanation: Dans une proposition négative au Present Perfect, 'yet' réaffirme en fin d'énoncé que l'événement ne s'est pas encore produit.

questions.question: The novel had ... hit the bookstores when major Hollywood studios bid for film rights.
questions.explanation: 'Had hardly + participe passé... when' exprime l'immédiateté de la seconde action par rapport à la première.

questions.question: ... entering the hazardous containment unit, all technicians put on sealed hazmat suits.
questions.explanation: L'enfilage des combinaisons précédant l'entrée dans la salle, 'Before + V-ing' est le connecteur logique et chronologique approprié.

questions.question: It's about time our engineering firm ... its legacy database infrastructure.
questions.explanation: 'It's about time + sujet' requiert obligatoirement le prétérit modal ('upgraded').

questions.question: Which sentences demonstrate proper alignment of temporal markers with their corresponding verb tenses?
options: The suspect was arrested three weeks ago in connection with the jewel heist.
She had already published two research monographs before finishing her doctorate.
They have arrived in Melbourne two days ago on an international flight.
By the time we reached the summit yesterday, the sun will have already set.
questions.explanation: Les phrases 1 ('was arrested... three weeks ago') et 2 ('had already published... before finishing') sont parfaitement cohérentes. L'option 3 associe à tort le Present Perfect à 'two days ago', et l'option 4 emploie le futur antérieur pour un fait passé révolu ('yesterday').
